title: XShell Web Component Implementation
description: Describes the implementation object of an XShell web component.

dependencies.description: Declarative dependencies resolved before the component controller is created. Each property name becomes an injected controller dependency.

renderEngine.description: The rendering engine used by the component.

stateEngine.description: The state management engine used by the component.

templateRenderer.description: Optional generated or prepared executable representation of the template.

controller.description: Controller factory called by XShell with component runtime services and resolved dependencies.
